persona: Mid-level BMS engineer at an electric three-wheeler maker, light on functional safety
resumeText:
Rohit Deshmukh | Pune | rohit.deshmukh@example.com

EXPERIENCE
BMS Engineer, Sahyadri E-Mobility, Pune (2021 - present)
- Owned battery management system software for electric three-wheeler LFP packs.
- Developed SOC estimation using coulomb counting with OCV correction at rest.
- Built Stateflow charts in Simulink for contactor and precharge control.
- Implemented passive cell balancing logic for a 16-cell LFP pack.
- Built equivalent circuit models from HPPC test data for each new cell supplier.
- Wrote embedded C drivers for the battery monitoring AFE and fault handling.
- Defined CAN bus messages between the BMS and the vehicle control unit.
- Validated BMS releases on a dSPACE HIL bench before vehicle trials.

Graduate Engineer Trainee, Deccan Auto Electricals, Pune (2020 - 2021)
- Tested wiring harnesses and battery chargers on the production line.

SKILLS
MATLAB, Simulink, Embedded C, CAN, ISO 26262 (training)

EDUCATION
BE Electrical Engineering, College of Engineering Pune, 2020
